prompts.framePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Production-ready Unity 2D HUD panel sprite, a SINGLE reusable blank panel, transparent background.
Primary request: Paint one wide rounded rectangular bio-industrial status panel matching the attached Water Drain game character reference's soft hand-painted cartoon art.
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only, keep the cream / dark violet / mint slime world.
Composition: a single front-on horizontal panel with a 3.6:1 aspect ratio, centered with transparent padding. Simple rounded silhouette, thick lavender-purple rim, subtle metallic corner caps, two small cyan rivets on each end, a tiny lime slime drip confined to upper left rim. The center is flat dark muted purple, perfectly blank and spacious for code-rendered health bars and labels. Soft cel-painted highlights, no photorealism, no perspective.
Constraints: exactly one panel; no character; no text; no bars; no icons; no mockup; no watermark; no additional pieces. Interior must have low detail. Genuine transparency outside the panel.
prompts.portraitPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: A single transparent game HUD portrait sprite, square composition.
Input images: Image 1 is the character identity reference. Generate a close-up HUD portrait of the SAME small cream-colored drain ghost, black rounded eye-mask, two large warm yellow eyes and charcoal tilted drain-cover hat with bright lime slime bubbles.
Primary request: One clean centered bust portrait of the reference character looking slightly right, friendly and alert. Crop body at lower chest. Preserve reference's simple soft painted cartoon silhouette and palette. Hat fully within canvas.
Constraints: no frame, no background, no ground shadow, no labels, no extra characters, no sparkles outside silhouette; genuine transparent background. Clean readable shapes at 96 pixels.
prompts.sheet:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Production Unity 2D GAME SPRITE SHEET, 2048x2048 square, genuine transparent background, precisely 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 512x512 cells, 16 isolated full-body frames. No visible grid, labels, borders or background.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact character identity and painting style reference, not a target to reproduce the layout.
Character: the small cream / pale ivory drain ghost from the reference, black rounded eye-mask, TWO clearly open yellow eyes, tiny charcoal feet, DARK CHARCOAL tilted round drain-cover hat with visible grille, lime-green slime bubbles on hat. Cute compact slightly tapered body. SAME character and SAME proportions in ALL 16 cells. Never blue water droplet character. NO golden hat. Hat has fixed gentle tilt, not huge or wildly rotated. Soft simple hand-painted cartoon art, clean broad shapes.
Grid reading order top to bottom, left to right:
Row 1: four idle animation frames, slight breathing and tiny lime bubble changes, eyes open, relaxed.
Row 2: four running frames facing right: forward lean with small alternated feet, slight squash and recovery, clean silhouette.
Row 3: jump anticipation squash, upward jump stretch, falling with hat lifted slightly, landed squash.
Row 4: shoot pose with cream body recoil and concentrated eyes (NO projectile painted in sprite), hurt pose startled yellow eyes, dash pose strongly leaning right with compact shape (NO external trail), death pose sad closed eyes body flattened and hat lowered.
Composition constraints: each character entirely INSIDE its own cell, no frame overlap. Equal apparent head/body size in every cell except intentional slight squash/stretch. All cells character centered at x=256 of cell and feet resting at y=420 from cell top (including jumping poses for animation anchor consistency). Character occupies about 340 pixels width and 350 pixels height, generous transparent margins. No scene, no shadows, no text, no sound effect symbols, no weapons, no water streams, no sparkles, no loose floating particles crossing cells. Exact clean 4x4 layout is essential for automatic slicing.
